meta.name: saas-idea-validator
meta.description: Evaluates a software or startup idea against problem, market, competition, monetization, defensibility, and execution, and returns a verdict rather than encouragement. Use this when an idea needs pressure-testing before anyone builds, when deciding whether something is worth pursuing, when assessing competition or willingness to pay, or when a validated idea needs a first-customers and MVP plan. Default to scrutiny; the useful answer is usually the unwelcome one.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用无情评审验证创业想法,得到可行结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有创业想法但希望在投入开发前被严格检验。
copy.tagline_en: Validate your startup idea with rigorous, honest scrutiny.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a raw idea that needs tough validation before any code is written.

howto.what: 你把一个软件或创业想法告诉它，它会按问题、市场、竞争、赚钱方式、护城河、执行能力六个方面逐一追问和「挑刺」，最后明确回答：值得做、有条件才做、换个方向做、还是别做。绝不会只夸你。
howto.when: 当你想验证一个还没开发的软件或创业想法靠不靠谱、值不值得做，或想评估竞争对手和客户的付费意愿，或需要先做第一批客户和最小可行产品计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我压测一个软件想法：面向小企业的发票自动整理工具，包月订阅。
say.note: Claude会按问题、市场、竞争等顺序追问审查。

say.text: 我有个创业点子：给瑜伽馆做的预约小程序。想知道值不值得做？
say.note: Claude会输出明确结论，不做无理由鼓励。

say.text: 先别夸，说说这个主意有什么致命伤：远程给宠物看病的订阅服务。
say.note: 它会用「不好就直说」的态度找红旗与漏洞。

howto.what_en: Given a software or startup idea, it probes problem, market, competition, monetization, defensibility, and execution. Its verdict is one of pursue, pursue if, reframe, or don't pursue — not encouragement.
howto.when_en: Activates when you want to pressure-test an unbuilt software/startup idea, decide whether to pursue it, assess competition or willingness to pay, or need a first-customers and MVP plan.

say_en.text: Pressure-test my idea: invoice automation for SMBs, monthly subscription.
say_en.note: It interrogates in that order, then gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Startup idea: booking mini-program for yoga studios. Worth building?
say_en.note: Claude gives a clear verdict, not empty encouragement.

say_en.text: Poke holes in this: subscription telehealth for pets.
say_en.note: It seeks red flags and holes, verdict stays blunt.
